title: LGT-* items
summary: Master data and inventory stock levels across warehouses for LGT-* lighting family items as of 26 October 2026.
body:
The `LGT-*` item family encompasses lighting components and reflectors stocked across Northbridge Cycles' facilities. Inventory records in [[data-stock-on-hand|Stock_on_hand_2026-10-26_0900]] track balances, allocations, and open purchase quantities between the primary Manchester store (WH-MAN-STR) and the Leeds store (WH-LDS-STR). As of 26 October 2026, stock holdings across the family include front lights, rear lights, and reflectors.

## Stock on hand

Inventory positions as recorded at 09:00 GMT on 26 October 2026:

* **LGT-FRT**: WH-MAN-STR holds 4 units on hand, with 0 allocated and 0 on order.[^r1]
* **LGT-FR2**: WH-MAN-STR holds 907 units on hand, 112 allocated, and 400 on order.[^r2] WH-LDS-STR holds 53 units on hand with 0 allocated.[^r2]
* **LGT-REA**: WH-MAN-STR holds 205 units on hand, 65 allocated, and 0 on order.[^r3]
* **LGT-REB**: WH-MAN-STR holds 2,888 units on hand, 1,112 allocated, and 4,000 on order.[^r4] WH-LDS-STR holds 550 units on hand with 0 allocated.[^r4]
* **LGT-REF**: WH-MAN-STR holds 704 units on hand, 21 allocated, and 0 on order.[^r5]
